notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Added Full Gamepad support 
Now you can play the entire game with the xbox 360/one gamepad.
Press H on the keyboard or LB to turn the gamepad on/off.

 New features 

Added the ability to reset the cities already conquered, so you can conquer them again.
Now some bushes, once destroyed, drop some fruit that can be eaten to recover life.


 Changes 
The key to skip dialogues is now "Enter" on the keyboard and "A" on the gamepad.

 Fixes 

Fixed problem for which weapons were not spawned once barrels and crates were destroyed.
Fixed problem that in some cases prevented returning to the main menu.
Fixed various collision problems.
When the ship is destroyed, it now reappears at the port of the last island visited.
Fixed various problems concerning some enemies.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:

Added temporary weapons: destroying barrels and crates now you can find weapons with infinite bullets, that disappear after 30 seconds.

 Bug Fixes 

Fixed various bugs regarding enemy animations.
Fixed problem that prevented to conquer some Islands.
Fixed several small bugs in mines.
Various optimizations.


 Changes 
We can now skip the dialogues by pressing the space bar.
